quests.title: Stand by Me

dialogue.t: Haha, my dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon, my muse and my... Err, mini-muse!
Ah yes, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, of course!
Hah! Who's the mini-me here, anyway?
Raaawr!
Haha, come now, don't mind me.
Hmph, Paimon minds a lot!

dialogue.sit: Require ye the succor of your... mousses once more, then?

dialogue.t: Of course! However... Hehe, new inspiration means... that I'll need your help once more.
No problem! You pay every time, anyway.
Haha, wonderful, my little mercenary!
You see, I'm taking a photo of a Tepetlisaurus this time... Shh. Careful now, we don't want to disturb it.

This is my first time interacting with such a Saurian, but I've been observing them for a while now... Truly fascinating creatures they are, each with unique personalities beneath their hardened shells.
Hehe, this one's learned some basic commands after being fed a few times, to boot.
Still, I'm going to need your help, dear Saurian tamers, to bring the wayward Saurian with us and take a photo of it interacting with its fellow Tepetlisaurs.
Hehe, a simple task, eh?
Yup, super easy!

dialogue.sit: (Not that you're the one who actually has to do it...)
(And it's not as simple as you might think...!)

dialogue.t: Haha, yes, that's the spirit! Come then, bring me the stray Tepetlisaurus, and we can begin!
Here comes the Tepetlisaurus! Let's start taking pictures, shall we?
Capital idea!
Come then, help me find a Tepetlisaurus, and we can begin!
"...As fragrant flowers do the dark woods grace..."
"...Afore we part, grant me your embrace~"
Hmm? Oh, sorry, just humming a little ditty again.
Have you noticed? Our little fellow seems to have taken note of something... Family, perhaps?
It's heading over on its own! Come now, let's follow — we can't afford to lose it!

dialogue.sit: You defeat the enemy and smash open the cage imprisoning the little Sumpter Beast. It leaps out of the cage and sends a happy cry your way.

dialogue.t: Wow... Phew! Well, that's over. What a rush!
Shh—! Look...
*click*
Perfect.
Whoa, they're getting along so well... And here Paimon thought that the Sumpter Beast might get eaten... or something.
Hehe, now, now. Tepetlisaurs might look fierce, but they're actually gentle souls.
Well, that's the photo taken, and here's your copy. Ah, yes, and your payment... here.
*sigh* Here I thought we might capture an intimate moment between a Tepetlisaur whelp and an adult — but it seems the Sumpter Beast was one step ahead!
Hehe, c'mon, Sumpter Beasts aren't that annoying. Paimon's sure you think so too!
Well, it doesn't matter what I think — it's the photography judging committee's opinion that counts!
Still... It might be too dangerous for our lil' Sumpter Beast to wander about in Natlan's unfamiliar environs. And I happen to need a partner to help carry some things...
Why, I suppose I'll just have to take it in.
What about its original owner, then...?
Hmph. His own fault for leaving the little beastie out here in such a dangerous spot!
But anyway, enough of that! Fontaine's photo galleries, here I come! Haha... I trust you'll visit when the time comes as well, alright?
My apologies, but I must leave this nation now. Farewell, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Farewell, my little fellow!
Rawr!
Also... catch! A memento, so you don't forget me, little ones!

quests.description: Whenever you’re in trouble, won’t you stand by me?
